text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—I'm different from before. I'm sure that 
the me now can spread my wings without 
hesitation. I can shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: When I think about that, my heart leaps!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I will go savor the joy of running. And I 
will show you my greatest brilliance!
